paper_overview.sets_note: Set A, B, C, D — same questions, different order. Marks distribution identical in all sets.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi aur English dono allowed. Mixed bhi chalega.
paper_overview.pariksha_bodh_questions_in_exam: Haan — Yugbodh Pariksha Bodh ke questions exam mein directly ya similar pattern mein aate hain.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: NCERT alone kaafi nahi. MPBSE ke liye Pariksha Bodh + previous year papers zaroori hain.
paper_overview.official_scheme_note: MPBSE ki official blueprint hi follow karni chahiye.

sample_paper_vs_model_paper.sample_paper: Officially MPBSE ya NCERT ki taraf se jari hota hai. Actual exam pattern aur difficulty level dikhata hai. Format bilkul real paper jaisa hota hai.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.model_paper: Teachers ya coaching institutes banate hain practice ke liye. Pattern similar hota hai lekin officially certified nahi hota.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.question_bank: Previous year questions ka collection hota hai. Revision ke liye best — jo baar baar aya hai woh clearly dikhta hai.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.which_to_prefer: Revision ke liye: Question Bank > Previous Year Papers > Model Paper > Sample Paper. Sample paper exam se pehle ek full mock test ke taur par karo.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.refernce books for revision: Pariskah bodh, pariskha adhyan, navbodh, shivlal
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.revision_notes_vs_qbank: Notes se concept clear hota hai, Question Bank se application practice hoti hai. Dono zaroori hain — pehle notes padho phir question bank se solve karo.

question_types_in_exam.summary: Mathematics paper has 4 question groups: 32 Objectives (Q1), Very Short (Q6-Q15), Short (Q16-Q19), Long (Q20-Q23)

types.type: Q1 — Objective (MCQ, Fill blank, T-F, Match, One-word)
types.how_to_attempt: MCQ: sirf option letter. Fill blank: formula ya number. Match: 1-(b) format. T-F: True ya False. No explanation needed.
types.word_limit: Option letter, one word, or formula only
types.notes: 32 marks sirf objectives se — ye section sabse important hai Mathematics mein.

types.how_to_attempt: Direct formula application ya short proof. Show working in 2-4 steps. Box the answer.
Show all steps clearly numbered. Partial marks for correct intermediate steps. Final answer must have units if applicable.
Complete derivation with all steps. Prove statements step by step. For word problems: define variables, form equation, solve, verify.
types.notes: Maximum 4 marks per question. No 5-mark questions in Mathematics unlike Physics.

paper_pattern.note: Total 32 objective questions (Q1 mein, 1 mark each = 32 marks). Q6-15: 10 questions of 2 marks. Q16-19: 4 questions of 3 marks. Q20-23: 4 questions of 4 marks.
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Har section mein internal choice hoti hai. Har question attempt karna compulsory nahi — choice mein se ek karo.

difficulty_distribution.note: 32 objective questions = 32 marks jo relatively easier hote hain. Remaining 68 marks mein difficulty medium to hard hoti hai.

chapters.name: Relations and Functions
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Proofs and definitions — no heavy calculation
important_topics: Types of relations: reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence relation
Types of functions: one-one (injective), onto (surjective), bijective
Inverse of a function: conditions for inverse to exist
Binary operations: commutativity, associativity, identity, inverse element
easy_topics: One-one and onto definitions: fill blank
important_formulas: One-one: f(x₁) = f(x₂) implies x₁ = x₂
Onto: for every y in codomain, there exists x in domain such that f(x) = y
Bijective = one-one + onto — only then inverse exists
Number of equivalence relations on set {1,2,3} = 5
most_repeated_topics: Prove given relation is equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, transitive check)
Check if function is one-one and onto
Composition of two functions (gof and fog)
Find inverse of a bijective function

chapters.name: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Properties need memorization, simplification needs practice
important_topics: Domain and range of all 6 inverse trig functions
Properties and identities of inverse trig functions
easy_topics: Principal value ranges: fill blank or MCQ — easy 1-2 marks
most_repeated_topics: Find principal value of sin⁻¹, cos⁻¹, tan⁻¹ expressions (MP 2019, 2022, 2023)
Prove identities using inverse trig properties
Simplify expressions like cos⁻¹(12/13) = tan⁻¹(5/12)
Solve equations involving inverse trig functions

chapters.name: Matrices
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Matrix operations aur inverse ya Cayley-Hamilton theorem
important_topics: Types of matrices: row, column, square, diagonal, scalar, identity, zero, symmetric, skew-symmetric
Matrix operations: addition, scalar multiplication, matrix multiplication
Symmetric matrix: A = Aᵀ. Skew-symmetric: A = -Aᵀ
Inverse of matrix by elementary row operations
easy_topics: Types of matrices definitions: MCQ/fill blank
Symmetric: A = Aᵀ. Skew: A = -Aᵀ: direct MCQ
important_formulas: If A is m×n and B is n×p then AB is m×p
AB ≠ BA in general (matrix multiplication is not commutative)
A = (A + Aᵀ)/2 + (A - Aᵀ)/2 — symmetric + skew-symmetric decomposition
If A is symmetric then Aᵀ = A, if skew then Aᵀ = -A
For scalar matrix A = kI: Aⁿ = kⁿI
Cayley-Hamilton theorem: every matrix satisfies its own characteristic equation
most_repeated_topics: Express matrix as sum of symmetric and skew-symmetric (MP 2019, 2023)
Find A⁻¹ using elementary row operations
Prove AA' = I type problems
If A² = A (idempotent) type problems
Cayley-Hamilton theorem application: find A² - 2A + 3I = 0 type
key_mcq_answers: A is symmetric + skew-symmetric both: A must be zero matrix
If A is 3×3 scalar matrix and k = 2, then |kA| = k³|A| = 8|A|
Number of 3×3 matrices with entries 0 or 1 = 2⁹ = 512
If A is 2×2 square matrix then |5A| = 5²|A| = 25|A|
If A + Aᵀ = I then A is neither purely symmetric nor skew

chapters.name: Determinants
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: System of equations solving standard but calculation heavy
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Determinant se simultaneous equations solve karna (Cramer's rule / matrix method)
important_topics: Solving system of linear equations: matrix method AX = B, X = A⁻¹B
easy_topics: |cos θ -sin θ; sin θ cos θ| = 1: direct MCQ
Area of triangle formula: direct substitution
most_repeated_topics: Solve 3×3 system of equations using matrix inverse or Cramer's rule (MP every year)
Find area of triangle given 3 vertices
Prove determinant value using properties (row/column operations)
Find adjoint and inverse of 3×3 matrix
Check consistency of system of equations

chapters.name: Continuity and Differentiability
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Parametric, implicit, logarithmic differentiation need practice
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Continuity check at a point, parametric differentiation, implicit differentiation
important_topics: Continuity at a point: LHL = RHL = f(a)
Differentiability: f'(a) exists implies continuous but not vice versa
Chain rule, product rule, quotient rule
Rolle's theorem and Lagrange's Mean Value Theorem (LMVT)
Logarithmic differentiation for aˣ type functions
easy_topics: Standard derivatives list: direct fill blank MCQ
important_formulas: d/dx(xˣ) = xˣ(1 + log x)  [using log differentiation]
most_repeated_topics: Find k for continuity at a point — piecewise function (MP 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023)
Parametric differentiation dy/dx when x = a(t - sin t), y = a(1 - cos t) type
Implicit differentiation: find dy/dx when y is not explicitly given
Logarithmic differentiation: differentiate xˣ or (sin x)ˢⁱⁿˣ type
Second order derivative d²y/dx² problems
Prove Rolle's or LMVT for given function on interval

chapters.name: Applications of Derivatives
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Word problems need setup but calculation standard
important_topics: Rate of change: dr/dt, dA/dt, dV/dt type problems
Tangent and normal to a curve
Maxima and minima: first derivative test and second derivative test
Word problems: optimization (box, cylinder, rectangle inscribed in circle)
easy_topics: Rate of change of area of circle: dA/dt = 2πr dr/dt (direct substitution)
Increasing/decreasing: just find f'(x) and check sign
Second derivative test: f''(x) < 0 means maxima
important_formulas: Slope of tangent at (x₁,y₁) = dy/dx at that point
Equation of tangent: y - y₁ = m(x - x₁)
f is increasing if f'(x) > 0, decreasing if f'(x) < 0
most_repeated_topics: Rate of change: sphere/circle radius changing, find rate of area/volume (MP 2020, 2022)
Find intervals where function is increasing/decreasing
Find tangent and normal equations at given point
Maxima/minima word problem: rectangle with max area, box with max volume (MP 2022)
Find absolute max/min on closed interval

chapters.name: Integrals
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Highest marks — by parts, partial fractions, definite integral properties all needed
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Integration by parts (∫eˣ sinx dx type), definite integral by properties
important_topics: Integration by parts: ∫u dv = uv - ∫v du (ILATE rule)
Limit of sum as definition of definite integral
easy_topics: Standard integrals direct: ∫eˣ dx, ∫sinx dx etc — fill blank MCQ
important_formulas: ∫sec x tan x dx = sec x + C
most_repeated_topics: ∫eˣ sinx dx or ∫eˣ cosx dx using integration by parts (MP 2022)
Definite integral using property ∫₀ᵃ f(a-x)dx (MP 2020, 2023)
Partial fractions integration: 1/(x²-a²) type
∫sin⁻¹(2x/(1+x²)) dx type using substitution
∫(1/(1+3sin²x)) dx type: divide by cos²x substitution
Integration by parts: ∫x eˣ dx, ∫x log x dx, ∫log x dx

chapters.name: Applications of Integrals
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
important_topics: Area under a curve: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx
Area between two curves: ∫ₐᵇ [f(x) - g(x)] dx
Area of standard curves: circle x²+y²=r², ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1, parabola y²=4ax
easy_topics: Area of standard ellipse = πab: 1 mark
important_formulas: Area of circle x²+y²=r² = πr²  [verify using ∫₋ᵣʳ √(r²-x²) dx = πr²/2 for semicircle]
Area of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 = πab
Area enclosed by parabola y²=4ax and latus rectum = 8a²/3
Area between parabola y=x² and line y=x: ∫₀¹ (x-x²)dx = 1/6
most_repeated_topics: Area under parabola and x-axis (MP 2020, 2022)
Area between two curves: parabola and line
Area of circle or ellipse using integration
Find area using definite integral for given curve

chapters.name: Differential Equations
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: IF method and homogeneous need careful setup
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: First order linear differential equation using IF method
important_topics: Order and degree of differential equation
First order linear DE: dy/dx + Py = Q, IF = e∫P dx
easy_topics: Order = highest derivative, Degree = power of highest derivative: MCQ
IF = e^∫P dx: formula fill blank
important_formulas: Standard form linear DE: dy/dx + Py = Q
Homogeneous: put y = vx, so dy/dx = v + x dv/dx
Variable separable: f(y)dy = g(x)dx then integrate both sides
most_repeated_topics: Solve first order linear DE using IF method (MP 2022, 2023)
Solve homogeneous DE: y = vx substitution
Solve variable separable DE
Find particular solution given initial condition
Form DE by eliminating constants from given equation
Order and degree of DE: direct MCQ (MP 2019, 2020)

chapters.name: Vector Algebra
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Dot product and cross product straightforward
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Dot product, cross product, angle between vectors
important_topics: Types of vectors: zero, unit, collinear, coplanar, equal, negative
Addition of vectors: triangle law, parallelogram law
Section formula: internal and external division
Scalar triple product: [a⃗ b⃗ c⃗] = a⃗·(b⃗×c⃗)
Projection of a vector on another vector
easy_topics: Unit vector formula = a⃗/|a⃗|: fill blank
important_formulas: a⃗ perpendicular to b⃗ iff a⃗·b⃗ = 0
a⃗ parallel to b⃗ iff a⃗×b⃗ = 0⃗
Scalar triple product [a⃗ b⃗ c⃗] = 0 iff coplanar
most_repeated_topics: Find angle between two vectors using dot product (MP 2023)
Prove a⃗·b⃗ ≤ |a⃗||b⃗| (Cauchy-Schwarz inequality)
Find unit vector in direction of given vector
Prove vectors coplanar using scalar triple product
Find area of triangle/parallelogram using cross product

chapters.name: Three-Dimensional Geometry
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Distance between skew lines is calculation heavy
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Distance between skew lines or distance of point from plane
important_topics: Equation of line in space: vector and Cartesian form
Equation of plane: vector and Cartesian form
Distance of point from a plane
easy_topics: Distance from plane formula: direct substitution
Vector form of line r⃗ = a⃗ + λb⃗: fill blank
important_formulas: Direction cosines: l = cosα, m = cosβ, n = cosγ. l²+m²+n²=1
Vector form of line: r⃗ = a⃗ + λb⃗
Equation of plane: ax+by+cz+d=0 or r⃗·n̂ = d
Distance of point (x₁,y₁,z₁) from plane ax+by+cz+d=0: |ax₁+by₁+cz₁+d|/√(a²+b²+c²)
most_repeated_topics: Distance between two skew lines (MP 2019, 2022, 2023)
Find equation of plane through 3 given points
Find distance of point from plane
Find angle between two lines or two planes
Check coplanarity of two lines

chapters.name: Linear Programming
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Graphical method — standard procedure, only 3 marks
important_topics: Types of LP problems: manufacturing, diet, transportation
easy_topics: Corner point method: objective function evaluated at vertices: MCQ concept
LP graph: 3 marks — follow standard method
important_formulas: Step 1: Plot all constraints as lines on graph
Step 2: Shade feasible region satisfying all constraints
Step 3: Find corner points of feasible region
Step 4: Evaluate objective function Z at each corner point
Step 5: Largest value = maximum, smallest = minimum
most_repeated_topics: Solve LPP graphically: find max/min of Z = ax+by subject to constraints (every year)
Identify feasible region and corner points
Formulate LP problem from word problem

chapters.name: Probability
chapters.book: NCERT Mathematics Part I & Part II
chapters.difficulty_reason: Bayes' theorem needs careful conditional probability setup
chapters.guaranteed_annual_topic: Bayes' theorem numerical or conditional probability
important_topics: Random variable and its probability distribution
Mean (expected value): E(X) = Σ xᵢ pᵢ
important_formulas: Mean of binomial = np, Variance = npq
most_repeated_topics: Bayes' theorem numerical (MP 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023)
Prove P(A) + P(not A) = 1
Find mean and variance of random variable from distribution table
Independent events: check and prove
Conditional probability numerical

practical_paper.practical_exam_note: Mathematics has no practical exam. Internal assessment (20 marks) covers file + projects.

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: 32 objective questions = 32 marks jo relatively easier hote hain. Remaining 68 marks mein difficulty medium to hard hoti hai.

tips: 32 objective questions pehle complete karo — 35 min mein. Sabse easy marks hain.
Integration questions mein substitution clearly dikhao — partial marks milte hain
Determinant se system solve karte waqt: A⁻¹ banao, phir X = A⁻¹B
LP mein graph zaroori hai — bina graph ke marks nahi milenge
Proof questions mein: 'LHS = ... = ... = RHS. Hence Proved.' clearly likho
Continuity check: LHL, RHL aur f(a) teeno alag alag calculate karo
Vector questions mein arrow notation mat bhoolna
Bayes' theorem mein tree diagram banao — mistakes kam hoti hain
Integration by parts mein ILATE rule follow karo
Final answer box karo har numerical mein
Question number clearly likho — especially Q1 ke 32 sub-parts ke liye

time_allocation.note: 35 min — attempt all 32, no negative marking
10 min — check signs, units in word problems

targets.strategy: 32 objective questions mein se 25-28 sahi karo = 25-28 marks. + 2-3 very short answer = 4-6 marks. Total ~30-34. Passing ho jayega.
Good objectives (28-30) + very short answers (12-14) + 2-3 short answers (6-9) + 1 long answer (4) = 50-57 + 20 internal = 70-77 marks.
All chapters, all question types. Integration and 3D Geometry mein special focus.

highest_roi_chapters: Ch 7 Integrals (12 marks — must prepare fully)
Ch 4 Determinants (system of equations always comes)

internal_assessment.note: 3 projects + 1 practical file = 20 marks. Teeno projects compulsory hain alag alag exams se pehle submit karne hote hain.

exam_day_rules.timetable_source: Official timetable mpbse.nic.in par available hoti hai.
exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 3 ghante fixed. Bell bajte hi answer sheet submit karni hoti hai. Koi extra time nahi milta.

answer_sheet_rules: question_number_note: Haan — har answer ke upar question number likhna zaroori hai. Examiner dhundhta hai. Nahi likha toh marks confusion ho sakta hai.
set_number_note: Haan — apna set number (A/B/C/D) answer sheet ke cover page par compulsory likhna hota hai.
question_copy_note: Answer sheet mein poora question likhna zaroori nahi. Sirf question number likho aur answer shuru karo.
rough_work: Answer sheet ka last page rough work ke liye. Clearly ROUGH WORK likho. Rough work pe marks nahi milte lekin kaam aata hai.
supplementary_sheet: Supplementary sheet lene se marks nahi katenge. Zaroorat ho toh lo. Lekin unnecessary blank pages waste mat karo.
sequence_note: Questions ka sequence follow karna zaroori nahi. Jo aata ho pehle karo. Lekin question number clearly likho.
last_to_first: Haan — paper last se bhi start kar sakte ho. Koi rule nahi ki sequence follow karo.
long_answer_position: Long answers hamesha paper ke last mein nahi hote. Section D aur E mein hote hain lekin sequence alag ho sakti hai.
section_name_before_section: Section ka naam likhna compulsory nahi lekin recommended hai. Examiner ko navigate karna easy hota hai.
line_after_each_question: Zaroori nahi. Lekin do lines draw karne se answer clearly separate dikhta hai — good practice.
cutting_overwriting: Cuts se marks directly nahi katenge. Ek clean line se kato. Clean cutting acceptable hai.
short_before_long: Pehle short answers attempt karo phir long — marks nahi katenge. Jo bhi order suit kare.
sub_questions: Sub questions matlab ek question ke andar (a), (b), (c) parts hote hain. Har part ke marks alag alag hote hain.

pen_rules.note: Blue pen se main answer, black se headings/underline. Ya sirf ek color bhi chalega.

exam_writing_rules.rough_work_rules: Answer sheet ka last page rough work ke liye. Clearly ROUGH WORK likho. Rough work pe marks nahi milte lekin kaam aata hai.
exam_writing_rules.overwriting_rules: Cuts se marks directly nahi katenge. Ek clean line se kato. Clean cutting acceptable hai.
exam_writing_rules.cutting_rules: Cuts se marks directly nahi katenge. Ek clean line se kato. Clean cutting acceptable hai.
